_comment: KAN-112 10599: engineering caps for the next version. The frozen base (10583) is not rewritten. Not a live-trial approval; sampling and the remaining protocol sections are not approved here.

time.total_covers: every stage: setup, sign-in, deps, agent, capture, verify, grading inside the trial
time.preparation_outside_trial: recorded separately (preparation_ms); not on the trial clock

outcomes.execution_verified: execution evidence verified (model, CLI, billing route); NOT task solved and NOT tests passed
outcomes.incomplete_evidence: some execution evidence missing, truncated or malformed; missing billing evidence is unknown, never free
outcomes.usage_limit: 429 or a rate-limit window not allowed; stop, no retry
outcomes.coding_timeout: the shared 1,800 s coding budget ran out; the safely captured patch is graded under 10583
outcomes.auth_timeout: the 10-min sign-in window (or the remaining total) expired during sign-in
outcomes.infra_interruption: an actual host or network failure (kind + stage recorded)
outcomes.pipeline_total_timeout: the 90-min arm-trial total ran out during ordinary QB/setup/verification work (stage recorded); a workflow-budget outcome, not an infrastructure failure
outcomes.policy_violation: wrong served model, non-subscription key source, non-first-party provider, or overage on any event
outcomes.preflight_refused: refused before any sandbox; not an executed trial, but the slot stays visible

flags: all categories that applied are kept in flags[]; precedence only picks the primary label
grader_outcome: a separate field, filled only by the independent grader

accounting.reruns: separate approval id required; the original slot is retained

scope_note: contracts are preapproved after L1, so the pilot does not measure end-to-end automatic checklist generation
